provider_receipt.summary:
VERDICT: BLOCK
The joined result is unsupported. The supplied close receipts only state that two objective leaves were closed; they contain no leaf findings, bounded objectives, or verification evidence. The parent verify receipt establishes receipt lineage and a clean project tree only, which cannot demonstrate that the full approved objective was completed or allow independent validation of its analytical outputs. One close receipt also references a different project contract digest, but no corresponding project result is supplied for review. Approval would therefore violate the requirement to fail unsupported completion.
